scripts.build: tsc && vite build && npm run build:main && npm run fix:html
scripts.build:main: npx tsc src/main/index.ts --outDir dist/main --module commonjs --target ES2020 --esModuleInterop --skipLibCheck
scripts.fix:html: mv dist/renderer/src/renderer/*.html dist/renderer/ 2>/dev/null || true && rm -rf dist/renderer/src 2>/dev/null || true
